sources.title: RFC 9457 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs

coverage.taughtAt: Three V3 segments: resource/method DTOs, HTTP status/problem semantics and compatible evolution
coverage.assessedAt: Five self-check questions, OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec and static contract checks plus human design review
coverage.evidenceExpected: Three defined methods/paths, request/response payloads, 201/Location, 400/401/403/409/500 with status rationale and 404 retrieval, safe RFC 9457 errors, and additive optional-field evolution.

coverage.taughtAt: Independent request/status matrix and optional-version compatibility review
coverage.assessedAt: OpenAPI static checker and human-reviewed changed optional field plus older-client mutation
coverage.evidenceExpected: A written contract with status decision matrix, example payloads and a before/after compatibility diff, not claimed as running Spring MVC or payment processing.
